_about: AttestedEscrow lock ids for fiat trades. tradeIdHash = keccak256(utf8(tradeId)); lockId = keccak256(abi.encode(funder, tradeIdHash)), AttestedEscrow.lockIdOf. Computed independently with `cast keccak` and `cast abi-encode`, not by either implementation. Read by the aggregator (recoil-core/aggregator/crates/types/tests/fiat_lock_vector.rs, oif_types::fiat_trades::onchain) and by the Merchant Agent (repo recoil-labs/merchant-agent, crates/agent-core/src/chain/lock_id.rs), so both derive the same lock for the same trade. Test values only.
